name: cherry-pick-action
description: Cherry-pick a pull request onto a target branch and open a pull request.

scripts.build: esbuild index.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --legal-comments=external --outfile=dist/index.cjs && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.copyFileSync('LICENSE', 'dist/LICENSE'); fs.copyFileSync('THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES', 'dist/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES')"
